note: Public-source research. Buyer lists = main operators/orders, not complete. Verify buyers in SIPRI Arms Transfers DB (https://www.sipri.org/databases/armstransfers). 'model_search' links open Sketchfab filtered to downloadable models - check each model's licence. Costs/quantities: best public estimates found 2026-11-20, sources disagree - treat as order of magnitude.

ongoing_conflicts_reference.Russia-Ukraine war: ongoing, front stalled, peace talks deadlocked (ISW, 12 Nov 2026)
ongoing_conflicts_reference.Gaza: Oct 2025 ceasefire, near collapse, Israeli strikes continue (Board of Peace report, 18 Nov 2026)
ongoing_conflicts_reference.2026 Iran war (US + Israel vs Iran): started Feb/Mar 2026 (Operation Epic Fury); check current status
ongoing_conflicts_reference.US boat strikes Caribbean / Venezuela: Jan 2026 Caracas raid, boat strike campaign continues (War on the Rocks, 2 Nov 2026)

items.name: F-35 Lightning II
factories: Fort Worth, Texas, USA - main final assembly (Air Force Plant 4)
Cameri (Novara), Italy - Leonardo FACO, final assembly for Italy/Netherlands + wing production
Samlesbury, Lancashire, UK - BAE Systems, rear fuselage for every F-35
Palmdale, California, USA - Northrop Grumman, centre fuselage
East Hartford / Middletown, Connecticut, USA - Pratt & Whitney F135 engine
wars_past: Israel: strikes in Syria, Lebanon, Gaza, Yemen
items.pointcloud_notes: Very many good models (A/B/C variants). Clean hard-surface, great silhouette.
items.unit_cost: F-35A ~$92M flyaway (Lots 18-19, incl. engine); F-35B ~$121M; F-35C ~$111M

deaths.documented_incidents: No incident with an F-35 publicly confirmed as the shooter and a death toll.
deaths.context: Used in Israeli air campaigns: Gaza (~73,900 Palestinians killed by all weapons, Sep 2026 figure) and Iran 2026 (3,375-7,650 killed in Iran by all US/Israeli weapons, of whom 1,030-2,362 civilians, Feb-Apr 2026). Not attributable to the F-35.

estimate_model.buyer_to_target: ISRAEL (48 F-35I, US) > GAZA, LEBANON, IRAN

items.name: Eurofighter Typhoon
factories: Manching, Bavaria, Germany - Airbus final assembly
Warton, Lancashire, UK - BAE Systems final assembly
Caselle (Turin), Italy - Leonardo final assembly
Getafe (Madrid), Spain - Airbus final assembly
Munich, Germany - MTU, EJ200 engine (Eurojet consortium with Rolls-Royce, Avio, ITP)
wars_past: UK shoot-downs of Iranian drones April 2024
wars_ongoing: NATO air policing on the eastern flank (not combat)
items.pointcloud_notes: Delta wing + canards, strong outline. Several free models.
items.unit_cost: ~€100-140M per jet (estimates); Germany 20 Tranche 5 = €3.75B incl. support (~€187M each)

deaths.documented_incidents: No incident publicly tied to a Typhoon with a death toll.
deaths.context: Saudi-led air war in Yemen 2015-2022: 25,054 air raids, 8,759 civilians killed (Yemen Data Project). Saudi Typhoons were among the main strike jets, along with F-15S and Tornado; not separable.

items.name: AH-64E Apache Guardian
factories: Mesa, Arizona, USA - Boeing final assembly
Hyderabad, India - Tata Boeing Aerospace, fuselages
Lynn, Massachusetts, USA - GE Aerospace T700 engines
items.pointcloud_notes: Rotors make beautiful rotating point clouds. Pick a model with separate rotor meshes to animate.
items.unit_cost: ~$35-52M per AH-64E (new); export packages much higher
items.quantity_built_or_sold: ~2,500 Apaches all variants delivered; 800+ AH-64E new + remanufactured (Boeing, 2025)

deaths.documented_incidents: 12 July 2007, New Baghdad: US AH-64 attack killed about 12 people including two Reuters journalists; two children wounded (video published by WikiLeaks 2010).
deaths.context: Apaches have flown in every US war since 1989 and in Israeli, Saudi and Egyptian operations; no total count exists.

items.name: MQ-9 Reaper / MQ-9B SkyGuardian
factories: Poway, California, USA - HQ and production
Adelanto and Palmdale (Gray Butte / El Mirage), California, USA - production and flight test
items.pointcloud_notes: Long thin wings + V-tail: elegant, sparse shape.
items.unit_cost: ~$30-32M per aircraft; 4-aircraft system with ground station >$100M
items.quantity_built_or_sold: USAF programme ~366 aircraft (195 Block 1 + 171 Block 5, DoD SAR 2018) + exports; total not published

deaths.short: 10 civilians in one strike; 910-2,200 civilians campaign est.
deaths.documented_incidents: 29 Aug 2021, Kabul: US drone strike (reported as an MQ-9 Reaper with Hellfire) killed 10 civilians including 7 children; Pentagon admitted the error.
deaths.context: US drone and covert strikes in Pakistan, Afghanistan, Yemen and Somalia 2010-2020: 910-2,200 civilians killed (Bureau of Investigative Journalism). Pakistan drone strikes 2004 onward: 2,449-3,949 killed in total. Includes the older MQ-1 Predator, so not MQ-9 only.

estimate_model.buyer_to_target: US AIR FORCE > PAKISTAN, YEMEN, SOMALIA

items.name: Switchblade 600
factories: Simi Valley, California, USA - HQ and production
Salt Lake City, Utah, USA - newer loitering-munition production site
items.pointcloud_notes: Small tube-launched drone, X wings. Fewer models - may need a paid one or a simple rebuild.
items.unit_cost: Not official: est. $70-175k per round (Switchblade 300: $52,914 FY2023)

deaths.context: Used by Ukraine against Russian forces; quantities and results not disclosed.

items.name: M142 HIMARS
items.maker: Lockheed Martin Missiles and Fire Control
factories: Camden, Arkansas, USA - launcher, GMLRS rockets, ATACMS and PrSM missiles
Grand Prairie, Texas, USA - Missiles and Fire Control HQ
items.pointcloud_notes: Truck + 6-rocket pod. Free ones are rarer; good paid ones on CGTrader.

deaths.documented_incidents: 1 Jan 2023, Makiivka (occupied Donetsk): HIMARS rockets hit a building housing Russian soldiers. Russia admitted 89 dead; Ukraine claimed ~400.
deaths.context: No total count; HIMARS is one of Ukraine's main long-range strike systems since mid-2022.

estimate_model.formula: RU dead 352k x 30-60% artillery x 1-4% HIMARS

items.name: MIM-104 Patriot (PAC-3 MSE)
items.maker: RTX / Raytheon (system, radar, GEM-T) + Lockheed Martin (PAC-3 MSE interceptor)
factories: Andover and Tewksbury, Massachusetts, USA - Raytheon system integration and radar
Camden, Arkansas, USA - Lockheed Martin PAC-3 MSE missile (target 650/year by 2027)
Schrobenhausen, Bavaria, Germany - COMLOG (MBDA + Raytheon), GEM-T interceptor line
Europe in progress 2026: launch tubes from Poland, cables from Spain (Tecnobit), Diehl Defence talks for German PAC-3 production
wars_past: Yemen - Houthi missiles on Saudi Arabia
Iranian missile attack on Al Udeid, Qatar, June 2025
items.pointcloud_notes: Box launcher on truck - blocky, read well as points. Radar is a nice separate object.
items.unit_cost: Battery ~$560M-1B+ ; PAC-3 MSE missile ~$4-5.3M (US FY2027 budget $5.3M)
items.quantity_built_or_sold: Fire units: not published (19+ countries); PAC-3 MSE ~600/yr, target 650/yr by 2027

deaths.documented_incidents: 2003 Iraq: Patriot batteries shot down a British Tornado (2 crew killed) and a US Navy F/A-18C (pilot killed). March 2026: 3 US F-15Es downed over Kuwait, crews survived; Patriot vs Kuwaiti F/A-18 attribution disputed.
deaths.context: Mainly defensive: it shoots down missiles and aircraft, so it mostly prevents deaths. Not a casualty-producing weapon in the usual sense.

items.name: IRIS-T SLM
factories: Überlingen, Baden-Württemberg, Germany - missile and system
Nonnweiler, Saarland, Germany - Diehl warhead and motor work
Ulm, Germany - Hensoldt TRML-4D radar
items.pointcloud_notes: Few free launcher models; the missile alone is easy to find or model.
items.quantity_built_or_sold: Ukraine received 11 systems (2026), 12th due end 2026; Ukraine ordered 18 more (Jan 2026)

deaths.context: Shoots down Russian missiles and drones over Ukraine since Oct 2022.

items.name: Storm Shadow / SCALP EG
factories: Stevenage and Bolton, UK - MBDA UK
Bourges / Selles-Saint-Denis, France - MBDA France
items.pointcloud_notes: Simple long body - good for a fast 'flying' point-cloud shot.

deaths.documented_incidents: 22 Sep 2023, Sevastopol: Storm Shadows hit the Black Sea Fleet HQ. Ukraine claimed 34 officers killed and 105 wounded; Russia admitted 1 missing.
deaths.context: Also used in Iraq 2003, Libya 2011, Syria 2018, Yemen (Saudi/UAE) and India-Pakistan 2025; no totals.

items.name: FGM-148 Javelin
items.maker: Javelin Joint Venture (RTX Raytheon + Lockheed Martin)
factories: Troy, Alabama, USA - Lockheed Martin final assembly
Tucson, Arizona, USA - Raytheon (seeker, launch unit)
Orlando, Florida, USA - Lockheed Martin
items.pointcloud_notes: Launcher with CLU sight - many game-ready models.

deaths.context: Main infantry anti-tank weapon in Iraq, Afghanistan and Ukraine; kills are counted in vehicles, not people.

items.name: NLAW
factories: Karlskoga, Sweden - Saab Dynamics
Belfast, Northern Ireland, UK - Thales UK
items.pointcloud_notes: Simple tube - small object, good as a detail shot.

deaths.context: Used in large numbers by Ukraine in 2022 against Russian armour.

items.name: Leopard 2A8 (Leopard 2 family)
factories: Munich (Allach), Bavaria, Germany - KNDS final assembly
Kassel, Hesse, Germany - KNDS
Unterlüß, Lower Saxony, Germany - Rheinmetall 120mm gun
buyers: + many Leopard 2 users: Poland, Spain, Finland, Denmark, Canada, Turkey, Greece...
items.pointcloud_notes: Lots of War Thunder-community models. Heavy, angular - strong point-cloud mass.
items.quantity_built_or_sold: Leopard 2 family ~3,600 built (commonly cited); 355+ Leopard 2A8 on contract

deaths.context: Combat in Afghanistan (Canada, Denmark), Syria (Turkey, 2016-18) and Ukraine (since 2023).

items.name: CAESAR
factories: Roanne, Loire, France - final assembly
Bourges, Cher, France - gun barrel
Arquus (France) / Tatra (Czechia) - truck chassis
items.pointcloud_notes: InCom Studio CAESAR on Sketchfab (~18k tris) - check licence.
items.quantity_built_or_sold: ~700+ ordered by 15 countries (sum of national orders, estimate)

deaths.documented_incidents: No public casualty figure. 2019 leaked French military-intelligence note (Disclose, 'Yemen Papers'): 436,370 people lived within range of Saudi CAESAR guns on the Yemen border.
deaths.context: Also used in Mali, Iraq (Mosul) and Ukraine.

items.name: 155mm artillery shell (M795 / DM121 NATO standard)
items.maker: Rheinmetall, General Dynamics OTS, Nammo, BAE Systems
factories: Unterlüß, Lower Saxony, Germany - Rheinmetall 'Werk Niedersachsen', opened Aug 2025, ~140,000 shells in 2026, 350,000/yr from 2027
Scranton, Pennsylvania, USA - Scranton Army Ammunition Plant (shell bodies)
Middletown, Iowa, USA - Iowa Army Ammunition Plant (loading)
Mesquite, Texas, USA - General Dynamics OTS new plant
Raufoss, Norway - Nammo
Glascoed, Wales, UK - BAE Systems
items.pointcloud_notes: Trivial shape - can be rebuilt procedurally in TD; nice as massed instanced rows.
items.unit_cost: ~$8,000 per shell (2026, up from ~$2,000 before 2022); Europe ~€4-8k
items.quantity_built_or_sold: US ~36,000/month (Mar 2026, goal 100,000); Rheinmetall capacity ~1.1M/yr; Unterlüß 140,000 in 2026; EU target 2M/yr

deaths.short: Not attributable (artillery = main killer of the Ukraine war)
deaths.context: Artillery was widely estimated at 70-80% of casualties early in the Ukraine war (contested figure; drones overtook artillery by 2026). Russian dead confirmed by name: 248,000+ (Mediazona/BBC, Sep 2026), all causes.

estimate_model.formula: RU dead 352k x 30-60% artillery x 30-60% NATO 155

items.name: GBU-39 Small Diameter Bomb
factories: St. Charles, Missouri, USA - Boeing (also JDAM kits)
GLSDB ground-launched version: Boeing + Saab (Sweden)
wars_past: Gaza - documented in Rafah strike May 2024
wars_ongoing: 2026 Iran war (likely, not confirmed in sources checked)
items.quantity_built_or_sold: 17,000+ built (older public figure); US budgets plan ~49,500 from FY2018

deaths.documented_incidents: 26 May 2024, Rafah: strike on a displaced-people tent camp killed at least 45 (Gaza Health Ministry), 240+ wounded; GBU-39 fragments identified by NYT and CNN.
deaths.context: Used by Israel throughout Gaza and Lebanon, by the Saudi coalition in Yemen, and by Ukraine (GLSDB); no total count.

items.name: DJI Mavic (commercial drone rigged by armed groups)
items.category: commercial quadcopter used as grenade dropper
factories: Shenzhen, China - DJI (NOT Europe/USA: added as the cheap drone of armed groups)
items.quantity_built_or_sold: millions; DJI ~70% of world consumer drones (2025 est.), 94% in 2021 (DroneAnalyst)

deaths.documented_incidents: No count attributable to the drone type
deaths.context: Typical payload 1-2 VOG-17 type grenades (CTC Sentinel 2025)

estimate_model.buyer_to_target: ARMED GROUPS (RETAIL, CN) > UKRAINE, MYANMAR, MEXICO

deaths_note: No public source counts deaths per weapon system. 'documented_incidents' = strikes where the weapon was identified; 'context' = wider campaign totals for all weapons, NOT attributable to this object. Researched 2026-11-20.
